methodology.sampling: Node inspector CPU profiler, no instruction/event callbacks or production instrumentation. Profiles run sequentially; construction, lowering, warmup, comparison, hashing and profile serialization are outside the capture window.
methodology.naming: Clang -O3 link followed by the same wasm-opt -O3 pass with --print-function-map gives the optimized function name/index mapping. The link map supplies source-object ownership only. The rebuilt runtime must match every production byte. Diagnostic names are attached to that production binary in a custom name section; all executable sections remain identical. Generated instruction/block/driver names follow existing manifest mapping, block order and exports.
methodology.attribution: Self/leaf sample counts are observations, not exact exclusive times. Inclusive samples count ancestors and overlap; do not sum them. O3/V8 inlining attributes inlined work to the surviving containing frame. Body categories describe function ownership, not pure subsystem cost. Native bridge bodies may include inlined pin/audio/clock work.
methodology.window: workStackSamples retain samples with public capturePhysical or run in their recorded ancestors. Capture cases retain historical capture* aliases. GC/VM samples may lack this ancestry; total-profile categories remain available. Requested interval is not guaranteed; actual deltas/gaps are retained in raw profiles.
methodology.limits: Single Node host, profiler overhead and tiering, no affinity/GC/frequency control. No parallel benchmark is launched by this script. OS/other application load is uncontrolled. Sampling resolves likely hotspots, not causal speedup, exact call counts or browser AudioWorklet latency.

retention.note: Retain all work-stack frame/category samples. Omit duplicated capture aliases and all-window frame/category inventories; complete originals and raw profiles remain under ignored build/.
